# dySim

The goal of `dySim` is to simplify the process of running a variety of
Monte Carlo simulations for the purpose of evaluating methods of dyadic
data analysis. `dySim` piggybacks heavily on the `lavaan` and `dySEM`
packages.

The `dySim` logo was designed by the *amazing* Lowell Deranleau (for
logo design inquiries, email: <agangofwolves@gmail.com>).

## Installation

You can install the development version of dySim from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("jsakaluk/dySim")
```

## Development Update

After laying dormant, I have recently started development on `dySim`
again. It is being brought into alignment with the current (and rapidly
growing) functionality of `dySEM`. I am intending `dySim` to support
simulations of:

- parameter estimation bias, accuracy, and coverage
- statistical power and sample size planning
- model evaluation and selection

Would-be users should expect large changes to the API and functionality
in the near future. I will be updating the documentation and vignettes
as I go, but for now, please reach out if you have questions about how
to use `dySim` or if you have suggestions for features to add.

## Collaboration and Troubleshooting

Please submit any problems or feature requests via the `dySim`
[issues](https://github.com/jsakaluk/dySim/issues) page.

If you are interested in collaborating on the development of `dySim`,
please contact Dr. Sakaluk.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calc_bias_rmse()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/calc_bias_rmse.md)
  [`calc_coverage()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/calc_bias_rmse.md)
  [`calc_power()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/calc_bias_rmse.md)
  : Calculate Simulation Performance Metrics
- [`create_design()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/create_design.md)
  [`run_multifactor()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/create_design.md)
  : Create Simulation Design Grid
- [`create_modelchoice_design()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/create_modelchoice_design.md)
  : Create Model Choice Simulation Design
- [`expand_pop_values_x()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/expand_pop_values_x.md)
  : Expand pop_values_x Into Scenarios
- [`extract_param_estimates()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/extract_param_estimates.md)
  : Extract Parameter Estimates from Simulation Results
- [`fit_dyadic_model()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/fit_dyadic_model.md)
  [`fit_uni()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/fit_dyadic_model.md)
  [`fit_cor()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/fit_dyadic_model.md)
  : Fit Dyadic CFA Models to Data
- [`fit_icc_model()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/fit_icc_model.md)
  : Fit an ICC Model via dyLMM
- [`generate_dyadic_cor()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/generate_dyadic_cor.md)
  : Generate data from correlated dyadic CFA population model.
- [`generate_dyadic_uni()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/generate_dyadic_uni.md)
  : Generate data from unidimensional dyadic CFA population model.
- [`plot_bias()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/plot_bias.md)
  [`plot_coverage()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/plot_bias.md)
  [`plot_power()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/plot_bias.md)
  : Plot Simulation Results
- [`plot_modelchoice()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/plot_modelchoice.md)
  : Plot Model Choice Sensitivity and Specificity
- [`run_bias_analysis()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/run_bias_analysis.md)
  : Run Bias Analysis
- [`run_modelchoice_analysis()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/run_modelchoice_analysis.md)
  : Run Model Choice Analysis
- [`run_one_scenario()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/run_one_scenario.md)
  : Run One Simulation Scenario
- [`run_power_analysis()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/run_power_analysis.md)
  : Run Power Analysis
- [`run_simulation()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/run_simulation.md)
  : Run simulation over design grid.
- [`summarize_bias_by()`](https://jsakaluk.github.io/dySim/reference/summarize_bias_by.md)
  : Summarize Bias and RMSE by Design Conditions
